messages:
Maya: Heads-up — spotted a 404 in the runtime guide while following the onboarding sample. The 'KV caching' section has a link to /runtime/kv-cache-config which returns 404.

Maya: Repro:

```
curl -I https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache-config
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
```

Alex: Thanks for flagging — can you paste the exact page URL? I can check CODEOWNERS and see who last touched it.

Maya: Found on https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache#prefix-caching (bottom of the page).

Sam: I can take this, looks like a one-line fix or a missing redirect. I'll open a PR to replace the link to /runtime/kv-caching-config unless anyone objects.

Jules: Quick note — this also breaks the onboarding quickstart curl in the tutorial, so it'd be good to get it in before next deploy. @Alex can we fast-track?

Alex: Opening a quick PR to swap the link and add a redirect: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12345 — @Sam can you review when you have a minute?

Sam: On it, will review in ~30m. Left one tiny comment about the diagram alt text on the page.

DocsBot: Automatic link scan created ticket DOCS-482 for runtime/kv-cache-config (priority: medium).

Maya: Also, can we avoid hardcoding internal runtime paths in onboarding snippets? Those move and cause churn. Maybe use the shortlink helper or a runtime config variable.

Alex: Agreed — filing a follow-up issue to add a docs lint rule for disallowing bare /runtime/ paths in quickstart snippets. I'll add the team as reviewers for any PRs touching runtime headings.

Sam: LGTM on the PR after addressing the nit. CI is passing locally.

Alex: I'll merge once CI finishes. @Maya would you mind smoke-testing staging after merge and confirming the quickstart works?

Maya: Yup, I'll test and report back here.

Noah: Noted and watching — tagging oncall for visibility. If this causes any customer confusion I'll raise an Ops alert.

Maya: Merge completed, redirect in place, quickstart curl returns 200 and docs render correctly :tada:

Alex: Great work — thanks for the quick turnaround everyone :thumbsup:
